prompt: A wide armoured siege ram front, like a fortress gate: a broad flat front wall of dark iron plate and dark timber planking, twice as wide as it is tall, bound by vertical brass straps; a large round iron door in the middle of that wall, standing open with fire inside; a heavy timber ramp lowered flat on each side; a short chimney at each top corner.
